title: Counter-Selector: reverse recognition and capability recovery
purpose: Find and test high-output, low-legibility operators and teams by operational residue rather than conventional status metadata, while refusing to create a hidden-genius ranking, identity-based preference system, or self-sealing selector.
working_proposition: Conventional selectors systematically miss some capable operators because titles, credentials, employer prestige, specialization, polish, and network sponsorship are lower-cost proxies than direct evaluation of locomotion, exception handling, custody, transfer, and model updating.
counter_selector_rule: Evaluate the artifact and state transition before evaluating the biography. An evaluator's inability to reconstruct a capability creates an acquisition requirement, not a negative capability finding.
selection_unit: one pseudonymous candidate plus one bounded artifact, transition, custody event, or repair event

operational_residues.name: support_adjusted_surplus
operational_residues.question: Does the candidate produce valid surplus beyond what the documented support, authority, time, tools, and stability would normally predict?
operational_residues.forbidden_shortcut: precarity, trauma, or missing support proves talent

operational_residues.name: cross_domain_transfer
operational_residues.question: Does the same locomotion method recur across unrelated domains without collapsing local requirements?

operational_residues.name: exception_handling
operational_residues.question: When the script breaks, does the candidate detect propagation, choose the decisive intervention, and restore a recoverable state?
operational_residues.forbidden_shortcut: vivid failure vocabulary proves actual recovery capacity

operational_residues.name: custody_and_restore
operational_residues.question: Are borrowed accounts, data, equipment, projects, people, or institutional records returned usable, attributable, and recoverable?

operational_residues.name: model_elasticity
operational_residues.question: Can an accurate contradiction enter the model without being converted into retaliation, concealment, or permanent rupture?

operational_residues.name: governed_capacity
operational_residues.question: Does the candidate allocate attention and force proportionally rather than performing maximum capacity for status?
operational_residues.forbidden_shortcut: low visible effort proves low capacity or high visible effort proves mastery

operational_residues.name: non_zero_sum_orientation
operational_residues.question: Can another capable person enlarge the system without becoming a threat that must be diminished or absorbed?

operational_residues.name: epistemic_restraint
operational_residues.question: Does the candidate distinguish observation, inference, proof ceiling, missing receipt, alternative explanation, and falsifier?
operational_residues.forbidden_shortcut: confidence or caution proves evidentiary discipline

review_stages.name: artifact_intake
review_stages.required: one bounded artifact or state transition with inspectable provenance

review_stages.name: blind_first_review
review_stages.required: review without title, employer, school, follower count, demographic identity, or network sponsorship where lawful and practicable

review_stages.name: support_ledger
review_stages.required: time, tools, authority, money, collaborators, institutional access, state load, and missing support

review_stages.name: transfer_test
review_stages.required: one bounded unfamiliar domain or documented prior transfer
review_stages.output: transfer result without universal capability inference

review_stages.name: disruption_test
review_stages.required: one changed requirement, removed tool, false source, dependency failure, or revealed harm

review_stages.name: custody_and_handoff
review_stages.required: next operator can inspect, resume, reverse, or safely decline the work

review_stages.name: second_party_review
review_stages.required: independent reviewer evaluates evidence vector, false-positive controls, and task fit

review_stages.name: bounded_collaboration
review_stages.required: candidate consent, task-specific scope, compensation or reciprocal value, stop rule, and exit

false_positive_controls.name: grievance_only_outsider
false_positive_controls.failure_signal: every failure proves persecution and no external artifact can change the story

false_positive_controls.name: secret_project_preserving_imagined_value
false_positive_controls.failure_signal: value remains unfalsifiable because the object is never exposed to users, tests, or handoff

false_positive_controls.name: ai_oracle_motive_strategy
false_positive_controls.failure_signal: AI-generated narratives about other minds substitute for chronology, behavior, sources, and repairable action

false_positive_controls.name: charismatic_novelty_claim
false_positive_controls.failure_signal: language and confidence exceed artifact validity, transfer, or custody

false_positive_controls.name: high_output_custody_failure
false_positive_controls.failure_signal: surplus is generated by externalizing damage, cleanup, debt, or unusable state onto others

false_positive_controls.name: single_tool_dependency
false_positive_controls.failure_signal: capability disappears when one model, platform, collaborator, or privileged interface is removed

false_positive_controls.name: scripted_performance_only
false_positive_controls.failure_signal: candidate performs while conditions remain clean but cannot localize or recover from disruption

false_positive_controls.name: affinity_mimic
false_positive_controls.failure_signal: shared politics, language, taste, identity, or criticism of incumbents is mistaken for operational fit

positive_controls.name: credentialed_specialist_with_valid_output
positive_controls.purpose: prevent outsider status from becoming an automatic bonus

positive_controls.name: low_legibility_operator_with_clean_handoff
positive_controls.purpose: test whether the filter can recover validated capability without prestige cues

positive_controls.name: narrow_expert_without_cross_domain_transfer
positive_controls.purpose: keep specialization and generalist transfer distinct

positive_controls.name: repair_capable_partner
positive_controls.purpose: observe direct contradiction, response, correction, continued cooperation, and later return

positive_controls.name: supported_operator_with_exception_capacity
positive_controls.purpose: prevent support adjustment from discounting real competence

positive_controls.name: unsuccessful_candidate_with_good_custody
positive_controls.purpose: separate outcome failure from operator quality

falsifiers: second_party_review_reverses retained candidates at unacceptable rates
counter_selector_systematically_rewards grievance narratives or confidence without evidence
selected candidates externalize more cleanup or custody damage than matched controls
candidate diversity collapses because the filter reproduces one founder phenotype
task_fit does not transfer to observed collaboration value
the program cannot publish failures and withdrawals without protecting its own selector
